normative_extracts.quote: Browser mode executes component tests inside a real browser page, providing native layout, CSS, and event dispatch without booting a full backend.

normative_extracts.spec_section: Testing Philosophy — Isolate & Test User-Visible Behavior
normative_extracts.quote: Each E2E test should run in an isolated browser context and focus on critical user journeys rather than unit-level permutations.

pipeline_phases: V8 Isolate Execution (Pure Logic & Fake Timers)
Headless Browser Frame (Layout, Paint, Focus, Hit-Testing)
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: The test fidelity spectrum maps each verification tier to the browser and backend subsystems it actually instantiates, balancing millisecond feedback against engine realism.

production_failures.symptom: CI pipeline takes 52 minutes per commit and blocks deploys with 12% flake rate
production_failures.root_cause: Team wrote 600 full-stack E2E tests covering every input validation rule and button state instead of pushing logic to unit/component layers.
production_failures.mitigation: Move validation matrices to V8 unit tests and component states to headless browser component tests, keeping E2E under 30 critical journeys.

production_failures.symptom: 100% JSDOM unit coverage misses broken sticky header and unreadable contrast in production
production_failures.root_cause: No browser engine layer existed in CI to compute CSS layout, stacking contexts, or computed styles.
production_failures.mitigation: Add a browser component tier in Vitest Browser Mode or Playwright CT for layout-sensitive UI primitives.
